comments.enabled: Set to true to enable WhatsApp notifications for bookings
comments.adminPhoneNumber: Admin's WhatsApp number with country code (e.g., '+919098888130')
comments.webhookConfig: Only needed if provider is 'webhook' or 'make'

comments.accountSid: Your Twilio Account SID (get from https://console.twilio.com)
comments.authToken: Your Twilio Auth Token (get from https://console.twilio.com)
comments.setup:
1. Sign up at https://www.twilio.com
2. Get WhatsApp Sandbox number
3. Add your phone number as verified participant
4. Copy credentials here

comments.url: Webhook URL to receive booking notifications
comments.options: Use https://webhook.cool, https://webhook.site, or Make.com automation
comments.format: POST requests with booking data in JSON format

steps: 5. Done! You'll see all bookings in webhook.cool
4. Join the sandbox by messaging 'join [code]' from your WhatsApp
5. Copy Account SID and Auth Token from Console
6. Paste all credentials in twilio section
7. Verify your phone number as a participant
5. Add actions: Send message via WhatsApp/SMS or Email
6. Paste webhook URL in webhook.url field
